title: Editor Add Node Visible UI Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor, Backend, and Core boundary context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, FlowDoc terminology, Work record, Editor AGENTS.md, Backend AGENTS.md, Core AGENTS.md, and Core cross-repo map are reviewed before editing visible add-node behavior.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor with bounded repo-backend/repo-core boundary references, phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-add-node-visible-ui, checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-add-node-visible-ui, and evidence target before edits.

items.label: Verify the Editor baseline in an isolated worktree before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor worktree C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-anui-0830 is created from main and passes npm run check before visible add-node UI changes.
items.verificationNote: Created branch fd-ed-anui-0830 from Editor main ae6978e3646e6ac4bbedc6ec15e6e38343bf0585. Baseline npm install completed and reported 5 high severity audit findings that were not remediated in this lane. Baseline npm run check passed before implementation with type-check, Vitest, and build.

items.label: Write failing visible add-node action and Outline UI tests before production implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Editor tests fail before the visible add-node action model and Outline UI controls exist, and a later disabled-reason regression test fails before the reason precedence fix.
items.verificationNote: Initial RED tests failed because the visible add-node action model and Outline add-action rendering were absent. A later RED run of npm test -- src/tests/addNodeVisibleActions.test.ts failed with expected Backend capability readiness text but received the busy-operation disabled reason, proving the test caught the reason precedence issue before the fix.

items.label: Implement bounded visible Outline add-node controls for Text and Columns only.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor derives enabled/disabled Outline add actions from current selection, Backend capability support, and add-node contract readiness, and keeps unsupported node kinds hidden or blocked.
items.verificationNote: Editor commit 10ee27089114400468a2faa586997b1bcb15abc9 adds src/editor/commands/addNodeVisibleActions.ts, src/app/useBackendAddNodeMutation.ts, and OutlinePanel wiring. Actions are limited to text-block.insert and columns.insert, carry target labels, expose deterministic test attributes, require compatible Backend capabilities for the active 2/3 pair, and send mutations through existing Backend transport and runtime stale guards.

items.label: Prove visible add-node clicks against a live local Backend server.
items.evidenceTarget: The browser smoke starts Backend and Editor loopback servers, clicks visible add Text and Columns controls, observes Backend insert operation kinds, reloads the document, upgrades, and reorders.
items.verificationNote: npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke passed in the Editor worktree and merged main. The retained fixture records addTextBlockStatusBar Text block added, addColumnsStatusBar Columns added, Backend operationKinds text-block.insert and columns.insert before node.reorder, and final outline order editor-text-block-zone-cover-body-1 > title > editor-columns-zone-cover-body-2 > summary-columns > detail-table.

items.label: Run focused, worktree, and merged-main Editor gates.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused visible add-node/outline/evidence tests pass, worktree npm run check passes, merged-main npm run check passes, and merged-main no-write browser smoke passes.
items.verificationNote: Focused GREEN passed npm test -- src/tests/addNodeVisibleActions.test.ts src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts src/tests/addNodeActivationHarness.test.ts with 4 files and 11 tests. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, Vitest with 98 passed test files and 338 tests, and build. Merged-main FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke also passed.

items.label: Record cleanup blocker and unpromoted product claims honestly.
items.evidenceTarget: Merged branch is deleted when safe, leftover folder state is recorded, and unresolved frontend/product claims remain risk or unknown instead of map truth.
items.verificationNote: Editor main was fast-forwarded to 10ee27089114400468a2faa586997b1bcb15abc9 and branch fd-ed-anui-0830 was deleted after merge. Git worktree metadata for C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-anui-0830 is no longer registered, but the folder remains on disk after git worktree remove failed with Filename too long; direct recursive deletion was intentionally avoided. A post-cleanup sanity check showed tracked Core deletions under packages/text-engine-rust-wasm, matching the known dependency-link cleanup side-effect shape; those exact tracked paths were restored from HEAD and Core status returned clean. Older cleanup risks remain separate and unmodified.
